## Where I am
The real replay into `events.replay.v3` finished: 18,442,107 events produced, 3,118 rejects written to S3, and PR #233 is merged. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 was at 61% at its last report, with 14.9M of about 20.5M expected rows in `events_v3` for the incident window. The incident stays open. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06, ses-rp-1)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12, reading `events.replay.v3`, not finished (source: r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, then compare counts hour by hour with a 1% tolerance (source: r2-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Close the incident only once the counts match (source: r2-07)
- [prochaine-étape] Daniel adds the CI check that fails if the dedup key builder can truncate (source: src-slack-incident)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; 5k batches work, and the memory limit is not to be raised (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Orbitly was told the Nov 12 data would be restored by Wednesday Nov 18, while Rachel told fernhill and orbitly Thursday (source: src-zendesk-orbitly, r2-07)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never produce to `events.v3` directly (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Only the postmortem fix goes in; PR #241 from the fork is ignored, and Daniel's CI check is the agreed fix (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
